LanguageData.MooGirl_Milk.label: Mugirl Milk
LanguageData.MooGirl_Milk.description: The milk secreted by Mugirls is sweet and rich, with a milky white hue and a light blue sheen. Miracle Star Genetic Engineering has endowed it with nutritional content far surpassing ordinary milk. When added to meals, it significantly boosts immunity and promotes rapid wound healing.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Wool.label: Mugirl Fur
LanguageData.MooGirl_Wool.description: A by-product of the Miracle Star Genetic Engineering programme- the fur of Mugirls, possessing the same light blue colour as Muffalo fur but significantly softer in texture. When sniffed closely, it carries a faint buttery scent.
